PWI R&D Writing Systems Engineer - Vision System 
 Description - 
 A Writing Systems Engineer is an experienced individual contributor responsible for owning system-level performance of industrial inkjet web presses, with a strong emphasis on hands-on engineering, on-press troubleshooting, and technical leadership.
 This role leads complex problem solving for vision-system-related functions, driving print quality, reliability, and robustness through a combination of deep systems thinking and direct experimentation. The specialist serves as a key decision-maker in resolving ambiguous, cross-functional issues and ensuring successful product delivery.

 Responsibilities 
 Hands-on system ownership & advanced troubleshooting (Primary) 
 Serve as the technical owner for the vision system-level performance, including print quality, reliability, and production robustness
 Lead hands-on troubleshooting on industrial web presses, diagnosing complex print defects (banding, mottle, nozzle behavior, edge effects, etc.)
 Design and execute on-press experiments (DOEs) to isolate root causes and quantify system sensitivities
 Drive root cause analysis across subsystems (hardware and software) and implement corrective actions
 Support press bring-up, ramp, customer escalations, and field issues, often in high-pressure situations requiring rapid, data-driven decisions
 Translate real-world vision system behavior into actionable engineering insights and design improvements
 System design & integration leadership 
 Define and develop system-level solutions to optimize calibrations and feedback to press operators on print quality.
 Lead integration of the vision subsystem
 Establish system requirements, performance targets, and tradeoffs across quality, reliability, and cost
 Understand customer needs and drive improvement vectors for the vision sytem
 Testing strategy & validation 
 Define comprehensive test strategies and validation plans for vision system performance
 Architect and guide execution of experiments, ensuring high-quality data and clear conclusions
 Establish and evolve system-level metrics and characterization methods
 Performance optimization & technical depth 
 Apply advanced data analysis and modeling to improve system performance and robustness
 Identify key sensitivities and failure modes, driving design changes across subsystems
 Balance competing requirements (throughput, cost, manufacturability)
 Cross-functional technical leadership 
 Act as the system-level authority across R&D, manufacturing, quality, and field teams
 Provide clear technical direction and influence design decisions across disciplines
 Mentor junior engineers and guide team problem-solving approaches
 Communicate complex technical issues, risks, and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders
 Program execution & ownership 
 Lead system-level aspects of NPI programs, from concept through qualification and release
 Define technical milestones, risks, and mitigation strategies
 Drive closure of critical issues impacting product readiness and customer satisfaction
 

 Education & Experience Recommended 
• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Materials Engineering, Physics, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
• Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in inkjet writing systems, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.

 Knowledge & Skills 
• Extensive experience in hands-on engineering, system integration, and troubleshooting of complex products
 • Strong expertise in fluidics, heat transfer, materials, and/or electro-mechanical systems
 • Proven ability to lead root cause analysis and DOE-driven problem solving
 • Experience with industrial inkjet, imaging systems, or printing technologies strongly preferred
 • Proficiency in data analysis tools (Python, MATLAB, JMP, etc.)

 Cross-Org Skills 
• Effective Communication
• Results Orientation
• Learning Agility
• Digital Fluency
• Customer Centricity

 Impact & Scope 
• Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process.

 Complexity 
• Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.

 Disclaimer 
• This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

 The pay range for this role is $116,150.00 - 171,350.00 USD Annual USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

 Benefits: 

 HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:
 Health insurance
 Dental insurance
 Vision insurance
 Long term/short term disability insurance
 Employee assistance program
 Flexible spending account
 Life insurance
 Generous time off policies, including;
 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
 11 paid holidays
 Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave ( US benefits overview )
 The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.
